bio: It is neither its sober contemporary décor nor its casual vibe that set Nénu apart from the many restaurants in the Avenue Louise neighbourhood, but its anh nhau concept. This Vietnamese culinary tradition involves sharing good food and a glass (or two) of something with friends and family. Start by sipping a delicious cocktail as you discover how the team adds a modern twist to traditional flavours, creating a mouth-watering menu (choose at least three dishes). House-made lamb wontons in a rice wine and pimento oil sauce, with smoked eel, duck’s tongues in pimento and lemon, etc… Superlative Vietnamese fusion cooking…...
